'''Ridu''' was a security officer of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he briefly commanded [[Elara Dorne]]'s [[Search and Rescue Squad 204]] during a visit by a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]]. The Senator was killed by [[rakghoul]]s due to Ridu underestimating the severity of Taris' dangerous environment. Ridu blamed Elara for it, and sent his report of the event to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kalor (Republic)|Kalor]] of the Personnel Division. When Elara caught wind of Kalor's inquiry, she confronted Ridu on Taris and made him recant his testimony with extensive contradictory documents of the incident.
